line: What if Stickman drew a rocket… and it actually launched?
visual: HOOK flash-forward: rocket blasting off through the window in a burst of smoke and sparks, Stickman clinging to a ladder under it; then quick rewind swoosh

line: He sketched one fin, two fins, a round little window.
visual: Stickman at the desk draws a rocket on paper with the pencil, line by line; each part pops on its word (fin, fin, window)

line: The paper shook. Smoke poured from the bottom.
visual: Paper trembles on the desk, crayons bounce, smoke curls from the drawing; Stickman leans back surprised

line: Three. Two. One.
visual: Big countdown numbers inside the world (on the paper / a sign), camera pushes in, everything shakes harder

line: The rocket tore off the page and Stickman grabbed the ladder just in time.
visual: Rocket rips out of the paper growing to full size, flies out of the open window; a rope ladder hangs from it, Stickman jumps and grabs it

line: Clouds flashed past.
visual: Vertical camera move upwards, Stickman dangling on the ladder, clouds whoosh past (parallax), birds scatter

line: The sky turned dark blue, then black, then full of stars.
visual: Continue the climb through sunset band and Earth curve into space; stars twinkle on

line: The engine coughed. Fuel: empty.
visual: Engine sputters with puffs, a fuel gauge needle drops to E (gauge on the rocket), rocket wobbles

line: Stickman panicked, then remembered the pencil in his pocket.
visual: Stickman panics (sweat, wide eyes), then pats pocket and pulls out the pencil with a gleam

line: He drew a gas station. On the Moon.
visual: He draws in midair; cut to the Moon where the gas station appears drawn line by line then becomes solid; rocket lands on the landing pad

line: A tiny robot rolled out, filled the tank, and handed him a receipt.
visual: Cute small robot on wheels rolls out of the kiosk, fills the rocket with the hose, prints a long receipt

line: Thirty million dollars.
visual: Close-up of the receipt: $30,000,000; Stickman's jaw drops

line: Stickman drew a coin.
visual: He draws a tiny coin and offers it

line: The robot did not look happy.
visual: Robot's screen face turns to an angry frown, steam puff

line: So he drew a bigger coin.
visual: He draws a HUGE coin that thuds down

line: It fell, rolled across a crater, and woke up something enormous sleeping under the dust.
visual: Giant coin rolls away across craters, falls into a big crater; the ground rumbles, dust rises

line: Two glowing eyes opened.
visual: Two huge glowing eyes open under the dust

line: A giant space whale yawned, and swallowed the rocket whole.
visual: A gigantic friendly space whale rises, yawns, and gulps the rocket (with Stickman) in one bite

line: Inside it was warm, quiet, and full of lost satellites.
visual: Inside the whale: rocket lands softly, Stickman climbs out and looks around

line: Stickman smiled and picked up his pencil.
visual: Close-up: Stickman smiles, lifts the pencil, it sparkles

line: What would you draw to get out?
visual: Big end question WHAT WOULD YOU DRAW TO GET OUT? then SUBSCRIBE FOR MORE card in the last ~2.5 s
